```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create a new column for age
data['Age'] = 2023 - data['Year_Birth']

# Set up the matplotlib figure
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))

# Create a scatter plot for Income vs Age, colored by Education level
sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='Age', y='Income', hue='Education', alpha=0.7, s=100)

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Income vs Age by Education Level', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Age', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Income', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Education Level', fontsize=12)

# Save the final figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
